title: Glessner House re-coursed to its 1880s photograph
items: The granite courses above the Glessner house's front door now stand about 4.5% taller, as a photograph from about 1888 and the 1965 survey both show them. On the Prairie Avenue front the courses now line up with the photograph's.
The 18th Street windows that sit on those courses rise with them. The north wall's paired upper windows are re-read from two 1965 photographs and stand about 2.5 inches higher.
